svg.title: Aurora architecture
svg.desc: Browser-only architecture. main.tsx mounts App.tsx, which switches between MapScreen, PlayScreen and TerminalScreen, reads levels from questions, episodes and puzzles, stores progress in localStorage and calls css.ts, which renders hidden script-free frames and compares computed styles. A service worker caches the shell. Hosted on GitHub Pages.
svg.text: A static shell, hidden frames and your browser.
